thread:
maria: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we need clear remediation owners, ETA for fixes, and final language for statuspage + customer notes. Also we have a recurrence signal on cache-init races across services. Keep replies in-thread.
aj: I can publish the statuspage once copy + legal OK. Do we want the statuspage to use Investigating vs Mitigated semantics here?
sam: I'll own the customer-facing incident note and a redactable RCA template. ETA Wed EOD (2590100000). Will include an opt-in request flow for detailed RCAs.
emily: I'll own the engineering remediation for the cache-init race. Plan: init mutex + TTL validation + defensive backoff. Target canary Mon (2590060000) with gating metrics posted to the rollout doc.
maria: Emily, please post the gating numbers here so Ops can validate before wider rollout.
emily: Canary gating: 95th latency <= baseline + 10% for 24h on canary subset; error spike <0.4%; CPU < baseline+20%. If pass -> staged rollout 10/30/100 with 1h watch windows.
kate: Legal: avoid firm customer promises. Use language like "anticipated" or "expected". For RCAs, require customer consent + redaction checklist before sharing customer-identifying details. I'll attach the consent form link once Sam shares the draft.
devon: @ops-bot ran recurrence-check: pattern cache-init-race appears 3x in last 120 days. Recommend a focused recurrence playbook: root-cause consolidation, pattern mitigation, and quarterly retro.
ops-bot: incident-audit-bot: recurrence-scan result: cache-init-race pattern detected (3 events) -> related incidents: 2571112222, 2582223333, 2563334444. Recommend scheduling recurrence review with SRE + Eng-ML.
rachel: For the customer note, suggest a short FAQ blurb: "How can I request an RCA?" linking to the consent form and redaction options. Keeps expectations clear.
sam: Good idea. Draft FAQ line: `Customers may request a redactable RCA via the consent form; requests are reviewed and redacted as needed before delivery.`
maria: Action items recap: Emily -> remediation + canary gating (ETA Mon 2590060000). Sam -> customer summary + redactable RCA draft (ETA Wed EOD 2590100000). Aj -> statuspage publish after Sam+Kate signoff. Devon -> schedule recurrence review + owner for quarterly retro (by next Wed 2590120000). Kate/legal-bot -> confirm redaction checklist and consent flow. I'll update the action tracker: https://tracker.redwood/incidents/2590001234 and sweep next Monday.
aj: Draft statuspage blurb for review: `Partial degradation caused by a cache initialization race impacting a subset of requests. Mitigation is in progress and service performance is expected to improve progressively. A redactable incident summary and RCA will be made available; customers can request a detailed RCA subject to consent and redaction.`
kate: Edit: change "expected" -> "anticipated" and add link to consent form once Sam uploads it. Also remove any absolute time promises.
emily: Uploaded gating doc: https://docs.redwood/rollouts/cache-init-2590001234 (contains exact thresholds and rollback criteria).
sam: Uploaded draft customer note: https://drive.redwood/incident-drafts/2590001234 — left redaction placeholders. Kate: can you confirm legal checklist by EOD?
kate: I'll review and respond by EOD. Legal checklist link: https://legal.redwood/rca-consent-template.
maria: Thanks everyone. Please keep future replies here so I can capture final commits into the tracker. :white_check_mark:
